features: 50 Hours Battery: Stay entertained for up to 50 hours with these earbuds. Unwind on long flights and commutes with your playlist for company

ENx Technology: Converse on calls clearly whether you are indoors or outdoors with ENx-powered quad mics. boAt Airdopes Pulse TWS Earbuds cancel background noise so you can speak and hear even if you are in a crowded area
Beast Mode: Say goodbye to lag as you game with up to 45 ms low latency of BEAST mode. With Airdopes Pulse, the winning spot is yours!
13 mm Drivers with boAt Signature Sound: Immerse into punchy audio from the 13 mm drivers. Feel the highs, mids, and lows of your playlist to the fullest with boAt’s bass-rich Signature Sound
ASAP Charge: Charge your earbuds for 10 minutes and resume entertainment for 140 minutes. Be it web series or movies, you can enjoy binge-watching with ASAP Charge!
IPX4 Splash and Sweat Resistance: Pop in your earbuds and relax to music at the gym, beach, and pool. IPX4 water resistance keeps sweat and splash away for uninterrupted fun
Bluetooth v5.4: Whether you are on the go or chilling at home, Bluetooth v5.4 wireless audio lets you unwind wirelessly
